requirements.requirement: The system must bind the PI credibility data payload from the backend response to the frontend data contract defined in EVAL-CT-PI-UX-S1.
The system must correctly map investigator name, institution, prior trial count, publication indicator, and score contribution fields from the API response to UI state.
The system must render PI credibility data in the UI when a complete and valid payload is returned from the backend.
The system must safely render partial PI data when one or more fields are missing without causing UI errors or crashes.
The system must display a fallback message when the PI data object is null or undefined in the API response.
The system must suppress rendering of individual PI fields that are null, undefined, or empty while preserving layout integrity.
The system must handle API response latency by maintaining UI stability and not rendering incomplete intermediate states.
The system must display a user-friendly error message when the PI data API call fails due to network or server error.
The system must prevent rendering of malformed PI data that does not conform to the defined frontend schema.
The system must log or surface a detectable error state when PI data parsing fails on the frontend.
The system must ensure that absence of PI data does not block rendering of the rest of the clinical trial scorecard.
The system must maintain consistent UI structure and spacing whether PI data is fully available, partially available, or unavailable.
